analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Limited held its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, to discuss financial and operational results for the half year and fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. Management reported strong export revenue growth driven by premium products like MCC spheres and SMCC, alongside higher trading volumes. The company discussed progress on Unit 3, noting delays in Phase 1 due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory approvals like CTO and CCA, with commercial production expected around June 2026. Management also addressed raw material costs, customer demand, and product applications across various sectors. Accent Microcell reported a 31.92% year-on-year revenue growth for FY26, driven by strong performance in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects a CAGR of 15% to 20% over the next 3 to 5 years at the company level.
guidance.quote: Just a moment, sir, at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

guidance.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 capacity utilization is expected to be around 60% for the first year.
guidance.quote: Sir. Look into the various guidelines in place. I won't be able to quantify in terms of financial figure, but yes, from the from current fiscal given a full year capacity, we are expecting it to be utility level, to be around 60% for the 1st year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the current MCC demand outlook is good based on their existing order book.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currency, current, MCC demand outlook is good, taking into account our existing order book.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has roughly around 4,000 metric tons of orders on hand between the domestic and export markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us.

demand_outlook.claim: Product inquiry has increased in the oral pharma and particular segments where the company supplies.
demand_outlook.quote: If we look into the oral pharma and particular segment where we have been supplying the product range, so, of course is, there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

demand_outlook.claim: Global market size for MCC is around 250,000 metric tons per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: I mean, see in terms of revenue. I cannot give you any idea at this moment, but in terms of quantity we are identified that the total of MCC. As such, is around 2,50,000 metric ton.

demand_outlook.claim: Export mix is currently around 65% of total turnover.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir. It's around 65 percentage of the total turnover.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is coming out with Unit 3 in a phased manner, where Phase 1 caters to premium range excipient products and Phase 2 caters to MCC.
capex_expansion.quote: we are coming out with, Unit 3 in a phased manner. Phase 1 will cater to, say, a premium range of excipient products, and Phase 2 will cater to MCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will have a capacity of 2,400 metric tons per annum for premium excipient products.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, sir, phase one at 100% capacity utilization. It will be around 2,400 metric ton per annum and phase 2 will be 12,000 metric ton but 2,400 should be read with the premium range of experience product that what we are coming out with.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 2 is planned for MCC with a capacity of 12,000 metric tons.
capex_expansion.quote: and phase 2, again will be MCC 12,000 metric ton.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial run for Unit 3 Phase 2 is expected to commence from July 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, trial run will commence from say, July 26, as I was stated earlier.

margins_costs.claim: Nominal increases in the cost of imported wood pulp have been completely passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: whatever the, say, nominal increase in the cost, for the import of raw material that is wood pulp has been completely passed on through the customer.

margins_costs.claim: Trading margins are roughly around 4 to 5 percentage.
margins_costs.quote: Trading margins are 4-5%, as compared to the, blended profit margins that what you are seeing in the phase of the profit and loss account.

margins_costs.claim: The gross profit percentage is around 38%.
margins_costs.quote: gross profit percentage is around 38%, so I guess, more or less, your concern, or rather, the question will be answered through that percentage.

margins_costs.claim: The price of CCS is approximately 3.5 times that of MCC.
margins_costs.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

margins_costs.claim: Export pricing for MCC is around 230 per kg and domestic is around 180 per kg.
margins_costs.quote: Sir. For export markets around 2 30 per kg. And for domestic is around 1 80 per kg.

margins_costs.claim: New premium excipient products have led to an incremental price increase of around 5% to 7%.
margins_costs.quote: so roughly, you can say around say, 5 to 7 percentage say, increase in the sales of finished goods because of the new range that we have started selling off

margins_costs.claim: Raw material inventory is maintained for around 2 months and finished goods for around 1 month.
margins_costs.quote: For remote. It's around 2 months and for finish course is around one month.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume achieved in FY26 was 15,000 metric tons.
The Pirana unit is operating at 100% capacity utilization.
The Dahej unit is operating at 95% capacity utilization.
The company currently has business orders on hand for about 4 to 5 months.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, we have at present about, you can say for 4 to 5 months. We have business on hand, and that's why.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 2 will be funded through a right issue and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Because Phase 2, Phase 2, we are going to fund it out from right issue, and to a certain extent, internal equals.

capital_allocation.claim: The total cost of Unit 3 Phase 2 will be roughly between 55 to 60 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: the total cost of phase 2 will be around roughly between 55 to 60 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: External factors, back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and licensing work related to greenfield project status caused delays in Phase 1 commercialization.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

risks_headwinds.claim: There are no supply chain constraints or negative impacts foreseen for raw material sourcing.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, the territory within which, from which we are importing the goods that would. There is no such issue so far. So we don't expect any kind of negative impact for sourcing of our raw material.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 2 to go live in the month of March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they will start Phase 3 almost in 2028.
management_commitments.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

management_commitments.claim: Trial runs for Unit 3 Phase 2 will commence from July 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, trial run will commence from say, July 26, as I was stated earlier.
